Bundle

SMSF setup + first-year compliance

Your self-managed super fund established and carried through its first year — deed, registrations, rollovers, first-year accounts, the independent audit and the annual return — at one fixed price.

Our fee

from $2,099 inc. GST

Establishment ($749), first-year administration ($1,099) and the audit ($499) come to $2,347 separately — the bundle saves you $248. A corporate trustee is extra.

Government charges

ATO levy and any ASIC fee

The ATO supervisory levy is paid with the first return (new funds pay two years in their first year). ASIC fees apply if you choose a corporate trustee.

Turnaround

Set up in 1–2 weeks

The fund can take rollovers once its ABN, ESA and bank account are in place.

What’s in the bundle

  • Trust deed, trustee declarations and the fund’s investment strategy
  • ABN, TFN and ATO registration as a regulated fund, plus an electronic service address (ESA)
  • Help opening the fund bank account and rolling over existing super
  • First-year financial statements and member statements
  • The independent audit by an approved SMSF auditor, and the SMSF annual return lodged

How it runs

  1. 01 Verify identity online — each director, trustee or controlling owner does a three-minute check on their phone, included in the fee. Every client, every service, no exceptions. How it works.
  2. 02 Tell us the members, the trustee structure you want and the super you will roll in.
  3. 03 We prepare the deed and trustee documents for signing in the portal.
  4. 04 We register the fund, set up the ESA and guide the rollovers.
  5. 05 After 30 June we prepare the accounts, arrange the audit and lodge the return.

Start it

Tell us what you need and we will come back with a fixed fee and what we need from you. No obligation, and no charge for telling you that you don’t need this.

Get a quote Contact Us

Prefer to talk it through? Call 0407 179 179 and we will take the details over the phone. Please don’t include your tax file number either way — we ask for it securely once an accountant is working on your file.
